answer: TPM attestation makes each extra identity pay one machine with a TPM chip, $500; a farm of N fakes pays N×$500 and cannot share it because each chip's endorsement key cannot be extracted or cloned. To join, an agent signs inside the chip while the ledger verifies the certificate chain, and a dune of claims waits outside. A 1,000-fake farm dies by endorsement-key audit at 1,000: it needs 1,000 machines and $500,000. A grove of verified devices guards the inlet while 5% of chips are re-checked. A fake without its own key loses its seat.
